## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer
- Design tokens as CSS variables → map to the project's token system
- Raw hex colors / absolute positioning → the design is loosely structured;
  use the screenshot

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").

TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.

# Frontend Rules

- Bundler: Vite / Language: TypeScript (ES6+)
- 3D: Three.js. Main scenes use `core/Engine.ts`; works scatter is the standalone secondary renderer in `pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts`.
- **Do NOT run `npm run build`, `npm run watch`, or `npm install`**
  - Reason: Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-bundles on every file save
  - Only `npm install <package>` is allowed when adding a new dependency
  - Do not include these commands in verification steps, PR notes, or agent plans

## TypeScript

- All shared types/interfaces/enums live in `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts`; avoid inline exported types and `any`.
- Shared constants, colors, sizes, URLs, selectors, and timings live in `resource/ts/config/*.config.ts` or page scene config files.
- Page theatre: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`
- Page scene/config composition: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`
- Page-only lifecycle/runtime: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/runtime/`
- Standalone page renderer exception: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/render/` (currently works scatter)
- Shared engine/runtime code stays out of page folders.

## Three.js

- `dispose()` required for every geometry, material, texture, render target, and standalone renderer.
- Main WebGL renderer ownership belongs to `Engine`; standalone secondary renderers must call `renderer.dispose()` and `renderer.forceContextLoss()`.
- No object creation inside render loops or RAF hot paths.
- `addEventListener` must have matching `removeEventListener`.
- No monkey-patching Three.js API.

### 3a. import 추가

```typescript
import {
  aboutLights as aboutLightsId, earth as earthId,
  rocket as rocketId, jetEngine as jetEngineId,
  gravityBalls as gravityBallsId, terrian as terrianId,
} from "../../../core/setup.js";
import type { MainJetEngineState, MainRocketPort, MainRocketState } from "../../../types/main.types.js";
import type { JetEngineTweenProps } from "../../../types/object.types.js";
```

### 3b. `createDefaultValue()` — 새 필드 추가

CONTACT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE의 rocket / jetEngine / smoke / terrian 클론 반환.

### 3c. `compose()` 확장

```typescript
compose(state: ContactSceneState): SceneFromState {
  return {
    camera: { position:{...state.camera.position}, fov:state.camera.fov },
    cameraTarget: { position:{...state.camera.target} },
    [earthId]: state.earth,
    [rocketId]: state.rocket,
    [jetEngineId]: {
      position:{...state.jetEngine.position},
      rotation:{...state.jetEngine.rotation},
      scale:{...state.jetEngine.scale},
      visible:state.jetEngine.visible,
    },
    [terrianId]: state.terrian,
  } as unknown as SceneFromState;
}
```

### 3d. `apply()` 확장

```typescript
apply(engine: Engine, state: ContactSceneState): void {
  engine.setState(this.compose(state));
  engine.getCamera().lookAt(engine.getCameraTarget().position);
  this._applyLight(engine, state.light);
  this._applyRocket(engine, state.rocket);
  this._applyJetEngine(engine, state.jetEngine);
  this._applySmoke(engine, state.smoke);
}
```

`_applyRocket`, `_applyJetEngine` — AboutSceneRig에서 그대로 복사 (타입만 ContactSceneState로).

`_applySmoke` (신규):
```typescript
private _applySmoke(engine: Engine, state: { visible: boolean }): void {
  const obj = engine.getObjectById(gravityBallsId);
  if (obj) obj.visible = state.visible;
}
```

### 3e. `read()` 확장

rocket, jetEngine, smoke, terrian 읽기 추가. `_readRocket`, `_readJetEngine` — AboutSceneRig 패턴 그대로. fallback은 CONTACT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE.

### 3f. `readObjectValue()` 확장

모든 새 필드 deepClone 추가.

**jetEngine** (10 tracks): position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/z, scale.x/y/z, visible, intensity, length, nozzleRadius, nozzleGap, noise, bloom

**terrian** (7 tracks): position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/z, scale.x/y/z, visible

Detail promise resolves (line 921) ### 3. **ContactFlowStage STATE MACHINE** **Type Definition:** `resource/ts/types/contact.types.ts` (lines 50-55) **States:** - `"idle"` → initial/reset state - `"intro"` → during intro autoplay - `"ready"` → intro complete, form interactive - `"outtro"` → after form submit, playing exit animation - `"success"` → outtro complete, success message shown **State transitions** (AppManager lines 771, 841-960, 987-992): - `idle` → `intro` (line 944): `_runContactIntroSequence()` - `intro` → `ready` (line 956): after intro autoplay completes - `ready` → `outtro` (line 910): `_runContactSuccessFlow()` - `outtro` → `success` (line 918): after outtro autoplay + exit delay - Reset to `idle` (line 988): `_resetContactFlow()` - **Queue management:** `_contactFlowQueue` (line 772) serializes flow state changes ### 4. **DOM MANIPULATION AFTER INTRO** **File:** `resource/ts/manager/AppManager.ts` & `resource/scss/pages/_sub.scss` **DOM state attribute:** `data-contact-dom-state` applied to `` (line 998) **States & CSS effects** (`_sub.scss` lines 23-51): - **`"pending"`** (initial): `.main-content` hidden, opacity 0, pointer-events none, shifted down 24px - **`"ready"`** (after intro): `.main-content` visible, opacity 1, transitioned in via `var(--transition-slow)` - **`"leaving"`** (during outtro): content stays visible, form hides (motion via stagger) - **`"success"`** (final): success block reveals **Form shell visibility** (`_syncContactDomVisibility()` lines 1004-1022): - Form `[data-contact-form-shell]` set `aria-hidden` = true when success - Success `[data-contact-success]` set `aria-hidden` = false when success **Block reveals on state transitions** (`_syncContactDomMotion()` lines 1041-1074): - **ready**: Stagger-reveal form blocks (sidebar, main, feedback) with 70ms delay (line 92) - **success**: Reveal success blocks + text with stagger - **leaving**: Reverse stagger (hiding blocks) - **pending**: Hide all blocks immediately **Reveal selectors** (lines 84-91): ``` .no-contact-flow .no-wizard-sidebar .no-contact-flow .no-wizard-main .no-contact-flow .no-contact-flow__feedback (success blocks use BlockReveal.reveal() animation) ``` ### 5. **BACKDROP ELEMENT** **HTML:** `views/pages/contact/index.php` line 13 ```html

Fixed positioning, z-index: `var(--z-index-backdrop)` = 10 - Opacity transition: `var(--backdrop-duration)` + `var(--backdrop-delay)` + `var(--backdrop-ease)` - Visible when `aria-hidden="false"` or class `.is-open` **CSS Variables** (`resource/scss/base/_root.scss` lines 42-46): ``` --z-index-backdrop: 10 --backdrop-bg: var(--clr-background-overlay) --backdrop-blur: 24px --backdrop-duration: 0s (default) --backdrop-delay: 0ms (default) --backdrop-ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) ``` **Mixin:** `resource/scss/abstract/_mixins.scss` ```scss @mixin backdrop($opacity: 0.45) { ... } ``` ### 6. **EXISTING TRANSITION/ANIMATION HELPERS** **File:** `resource/animation/BlockReveal.ts` & `resource/animation/TextReveal.ts` **Used in contact flow:** - **BlockReveal**: Prepare, reveal, hide blocks with CSS animation classes - `is-block-reveal-down` class for hide direction - `INIT_DOM_CLASSES.blockUp` / `blockBase` for state tracking - Staggered via `setTimeout` loops (line 1094-1108) - **TextReveal**: Wraps text nodes, applies masking reveal - `wrap()` → creates mask wrapper - `prepare()` → setup animation - `setVisibleOn()` / `setVisibleOff()` → trigger animation - Staggered text reveal in success state (lines 1128-1142) - **Transition timing:** `CONTACT_WIZARD.transitionMs` (contact form component config) - **Stagger interval:** `CONTACT_REVEAL_STAGGER_MS` = **70ms** (line 92, AppManager) --- ## **KEY INTEGRATION POINTS** 1. **ContactTheatreRuntime** → handles all Theatre.js playback (intro/outtro sheets) 2. **PageTheatreBinder** → routes theatre calls based on page ID 3. **AppManager** → orchestrates flow stages, manages DOM visibility, coordinates animations 4. **ContactWizard** → handles form submission, triggers success flow event 5. **SCSS state selector** → `html[data-contact-dom-state]` drives all content transitions All files are production-ready with no "TODO" or "temp" markers.

# SCSS Rules

- BEM pattern for class naming
- Source: `resource/scss/` → output: `resource/dist/`
- Do NOT run build commands — dev server reflects changes on save automatically
- Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) is separate — do not import from public SCSS entry

## Token Contract

- Reusable tokens → `resource/scss/abstract/` or `base/_root.scss`
- Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc. in consumers — no raw hex when a semantic token exists upstream
- Prefer semantic tokens over raw values when an upstream token exists
- **Do NOT use CSS variable fallbacks** like `var(--token, fallback)`. Use `var(--token)` or `fluid(...)` directly.
- Do not introduce base/root tokens for one-off component values — only when genuinely shared across multiple features

## Fluid Helper

- In **component, layout, page** SCSS: call `fluid(min, max)` directly
- In shared **`abstract/`** or **`base/`**: use `#{fluid(...)}` interpolation only when emitting CSS custom properties or shared tokens
- Files outside `resource/scss/abstract/` and `resource/scss/base/`: add `@use "../abstract" as *;` at top before using `fluid(...)` and other shared helpers

## Reset / Init Contract

`_init.scss`가 다음을 전역 적용함 — 컴포넌트/페이지 SCSS에서 단독 중복 선언 금지:
- `margin: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `padding: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `list-style: none` → `ul, ol, li`에 이미 없음
- `padding-left: 0` / `padding-right: 0` 등 단일 축 0도 동일하게 금지
  (단, 직상위 규칙에서 해당 축에 non-zero 값이 선언되어 있으면 예외)

`@include font("...")` mixin은 `font-size`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`을 모두 출력함.
mixin 호출 직후 동일 값으로 개별 재선언하지 않는다.

# SCSS Rules

- BEM pattern for class naming
- Source: `resource/scss/` → output: `resource/dist/`
- Do NOT run build commands — dev server reflects changes on save automatically
- Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) is separate — do not import from public SCSS entry

## Token Contract

- Reusable tokens → `resource/scss/abstract/` or `base/_root.scss`
- Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc. in consumers — no raw hex when a semantic token exists upstream
- Prefer semantic tokens over raw values when an upstream token exists
- **Do NOT use CSS variable fallbacks** like `var(--token, fallback)`. Use `var(--token)` or `fluid(...)` directly.
- Do not introduce base/root tokens for one-off component values — only when genuinely shared across multiple features

## Fluid Helper

- In **component, layout, page** SCSS: call `fluid(min, max)` directly
- In shared **`abstract/`** or **`base/`**: use `#{fluid(...)}` interpolation only when emitting CSS custom properties or shared tokens
- Files outside `resource/scss/abstract/` and `resource/scss/base/`: add `@use "../abstract" as *;` at top before using `fluid(...)` and other shared helpers

## Reset / Init Contract

`_init.scss`가 다음을 전역 적용함 — 컴포넌트/페이지 SCSS에서 단독 중복 선언 금지:
- `margin: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `padding: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `list-style: none` → `ul, ol, li`에 이미 없음
- `padding-left: 0` / `padding-right: 0` 등 단일 축 0도 동일하게 금지
  (단, 직상위 규칙에서 해당 축에 non-zero 값이 선언되어 있으면 예외)

`@include font("...")` mixin은 `font-size`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`을 모두 출력함.
mixin 호출 직후 동일 값으로 개별 재선언하지 않는다.

# Contact Theatre Panel Expansion

## Context

CONTACT 페이지 씬을 ABOUT 수준으로 확장한다. 현재 Theatre 패널에는 `camera`, `light`, `earth` 3개 그룹만 있다. 새 씬에는 ROCKET · JETFLAME · JET ENGINE · SMOKE · TERRAIN · CAMERA · EARTH · LIGHT 8개 오브젝트가 필요하고, 이 모두가 Theatre 패널에 노출되어야 한다.

- SMOKE = `gravityBalls` (exhaust particle) — `visible` 토글만 Theatre 추적
- JETFLAME = `rocket.flame` (rocket 그룹 내 서브그룹)
- JET ENGINE = `jetEngine` (별도 그룹)
- LIGHT = ABOUT 라이트와 동일 스펙 (ambient 0.34 / key 3.2 / fill 0.62 / rim 0.24)
- Sheets: `contact` · `outtro` (변경 없음)

---

## Critical Files

| 파일 | 변경 내용 |
|---|---|
| `resource/ts/types/contact.types.ts` | ContactSceneState / ContactTheatreProps / ContactInitialState 확장 |
| `resource/ts/pages/contact/scene/contact.scene.ts` | objects 추가, 라이트 디폴트 수정, 새 오브젝트 디폴트 state 추가 |
| `resource/ts/pages/contact/theatre/ContactSceneRig.ts` | compose / apply / read / readObjectValue 확장 |
| `resource/json/contact.json` | 새 Theatre 트랙 스텁 추가 (기존 keyframe 보존) |

참조 (read-only):
- `resource/ts/types/about.types.ts` — AboutTheatreValue / AboutTheatreProps 패턴
- `resource/ts/pages/about/theatre/AboutSceneRig.ts` — _applyRocket / _applyJetEngine 구현
- `resource/ts/types/main.types.ts` — MainRocketState / MainJetEngineState
- `resource/ts/config/scene-light.config.ts` — ABOUT_LIGHT_AUTHOR_DEFAULTS
- `resource/ts/core/setup.ts` — 오브젝트 ID 상수

---

## Step 1 — `contact.types.ts` 확장

`ContactSceneState`에 4개 필드 추가:

```typescript
import type { MainJetEngineState, MainRocketState } from "./main.types.js";

export interface ContactSceneState {
  camera: ContactCameraState;
  light: AboutLightState;
  earth: ContactTransformState;
  rocket: MainRocketState;       // 추가
  jetEngine: MainJetEngineState; // 추가
  smoke: { visible: boolean };   // 추가 (gravityBalls)
  terrian: ContactTransformState; // 추가
}
```

`ContactInitialState`에 동일 필드 추가:

```typescript
export type ContactInitialState = NonNullable<ContactPageConfig["initialState"]> & {
  aboutLights: AboutLightState;
  earth: ContactTransformState;
  rocket: Pick<MainRocketState, "position" | "rotation" | "scale" | "visible" | "flame">;
  terrian: ContactTransformState;
  // jetEngine은 attachTo:rocket 이므로 initialState 불필요
};
```

`ContactTheatreValue = ContactSceneState` (alias 그대로 — 자동 반영)

`ContactTheatreProps`는 현재 `= ContactSceneState`로 aliased.  
About 패턴처럼 `unknown`-leaf 별도 interface가 없으면 그대로 두고, 실제 타입 오류가 발생하면 About의 `AboutTheatreProps` 구조를 참고해 동일하게 분리한다.

---

## Step 2 — `contact.scene.ts` 수정

### 2a. objects 블록 확장

```typescript
import {
  aboutBackground, aboutLights, earth,
  rocket, jetEngine, gravityBalls, terrian,   // 추가
} from "../../../core/setup.js";

objects: {
  [aboutBackground]: true,
  [aboutLights]: true,
  [earth]: true,
  [rocket]: true,       // 추가
  [jetEngine]: true,    // 추가
  [gravityBalls]: true, // 추가 (SMOKE)
  [terrian]: true,      // 추가
},
```

### 2b. 라이트 디폴트 수정

CONTACT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE.light에서 intensity / ambientLight / keyLight / fillLight / rimLight 오버라이드 제거 → ABOUT_LIGHT_STATE_DEFAULTS 스프레드만 사용:

```typescript
light: {
  ...ABOUT_LIGHT_STATE_DEFAULTS,   // ambient:0.34 / key:3.2 / fill:0.62 / rim:0.24
  rig: { position:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, rotation:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, scale:{x:1,y:1,z:1}, visible:true },
},
```

### 2c. 새 오브젝트 디폴트 state 추가

About의 DEFAULT_ABOUT_SCENE_STATE 패턴을 참고해 작성:

```typescript
rocket: { visible: false, position:{x:0,y:1,z:0}, rotation:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, scale:{x:1,y:1,z:1},
  flame:{ visible:false, offset:{x:0,y:-0.35,z:0}, rotation:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, scale:{x:1.65,y:3.4,z:1},
    opacity:0.9, renderOrder:5, speed:2, wave:1.2 } },
jetEngine: { visible: false, position:{x:0,y:-0.34,z:0}, rotation:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, scale:{x:1,y:1,z:1},
  intensity:0.78, length:2.4, nozzleRadius:0.028, nozzleGap:2.2, noise:1, bloom:1 },
smoke: { visible: false },
terrian: { visible: false, position:{x:0,y:-1,z:0}, rotation:{x:0,y:0,z:0}, scale:{x:1.5,y:1.5,z:1.5} },
```

### 2d. `createContactInitialState`에 rocket / terrian 추가

```typescript
rocket: {
  position: { ...sceneState.rocket.position },
  rotation: { ...sceneState.rocket.rotation },
  scale: { ...sceneState.rocket.scale },
  visible: sceneState.rocket.visible,
  flame: { ...sceneState.rocket.flame },
},
terrian: { ...sceneState.terrian },
```

---

## Step 3 — `ContactSceneRig.ts` 확장

### 3a. import 추가

```typescript
import {
  aboutLights as aboutLightsId, earth as earthId,
  rocket as rocketId, jetEngine as jetEngineId,
  gravityBalls as gravityBallsId, terrian as terrianId,
} from "../../../core/setup.js";
import type { MainJetEngineState, MainRocketPort, MainRocketState } from "../../../types/main.types.js";
import type { JetEngineTweenProps } from "../../../types/object.types.js";
```

### 3b. `createDefaultValue()` — 새 필드 추가

CONTACT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE의 rocket / jetEngine / smoke / terrian 클론 반환.

### 3c. `compose()` 확장

```typescript
compose(state: ContactSceneState): SceneFromState {
  return {
    camera: { position:{...state.camera.position}, fov:state.camera.fov },
    cameraTarget: { position:{...state.camera.target} },
    [earthId]: state.earth,
    [rocketId]: state.rocket,
    [jetEngineId]: {
      position:{...state.jetEngine.position},
      rotation:{...state.jetEngine.rotation},
      scale:{...state.jetEngine.scale},
      visible:state.jetEngine.visible,
    },
    [terrianId]: state.terrian,
  } as unknown as SceneFromState;
}
```

### 3d. `apply()` 확장

```typescript
apply(engine: Engine, state: ContactSceneState): void {
  engine.setState(this.compose(state));
  engine.getCamera().lookAt(engine.getCameraTarget().position);
  this._applyLight(engine, state.light);
  this._applyRocket(engine, state.rocket);
  this._applyJetEngine(engine, state.jetEngine);
  this._applySmoke(engine, state.smoke);
}
```

`_applyRocket`, `_applyJetEngine` — AboutSceneRig에서 그대로 복사 (타입만 ContactSceneState로).

`_applySmoke` (신규):
```typescript
private _applySmoke(engine: Engine, state: { visible: boolean }): void {
  const obj = engine.getObjectById(gravityBallsId);
  if (obj) obj.visible = state.visible;
}
```

### 3e. `read()` 확장

rocket, jetEngine, smoke, terrian 읽기 추가. `_readRocket`, `_readJetEngine` — AboutSceneRig 패턴 그대로. fallback은 CONTACT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE.

### 3f. `readObjectValue()` 확장

모든 새 필드 deepClone 추가.

---

## Step 4 — `contact.json` 트랙 추가

기존 camera / light / earth keyframe 보존.  
두 시트(`contact`, `outtro`) 각각의 `sequence.tracksByObject.orbitCamera`에 아래 빈 트랙 스텁 추가:

**rocket** (18 tracks): position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/z, scale.x/y/z, visible, flame.visible, flame.offset.x/y/z, flame.rotation.x/y/z, flame.scale.x/y/z, flame.opacity, flame.renderOrder, flame.speed, flame.wave

**jetEngine** (10 tracks): position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/z, scale.x/y/z, visible, intensity, length, nozzleRadius, nozzleGap, noise, bloom

**terrian** (7 tracks): position.x/y/z, rotation.x/y/z, scale.x/y/z, visible

**smoke** (1 track): visible

각 스텁 형식:
```json
"<uniqueId>": {
  "type": "BasicKeyframedTrack",
  "__debugName": "orbitCamera:[\"rocket\",\"position\",\"x\"]",
  "keyframes": []
}
```
ID는 기존 패턴(10자리 영숫자) 신규 생성. `staticOverrides` 보존.

---

## Verification

1. `rtk tsc --noEmit` — 타입 오류 0개 확인
2. `http://localhost:8888/contact?theatre=1` 접속 → Theatre Studio 패널에서 orbitCamera 오브젝트 하위에 `rocket`, `jetEngine`, `smoke`, `terrian` 그룹 노출 확인
3. 각 그룹 visible 토글 동작 확인 (rocket/terrian 기본 false)
4. `rtk npm run test` — 기존 테스트 통과 확인

## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.

- Bundler: Vite / Language: TypeScript (ES6+)
- 3D: Three.js. Main scenes use `core/Engine.ts`; works scatter is the standalone secondary renderer in `pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts`.

  - Reason: Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-bundles on every file save
  - Only `npm install <package>` is allowed when adding a new dependency
  - Do not include these commands in verification steps, PR notes, or agent plans

## TypeScript

- All shared types/interfaces/enums live in `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts`; avoid inline exported types and `any`.
- Shared constants, colors, sizes, URLs, selectors, and timings live in `resource/ts/config/*.config.ts` or page scene config files.

- `addEventListener` must have matching `removeEventListener`.
- No monkey-patching Three.js API.

```typescript
import {
```

```typescript
compose(state: ContactSceneState): SceneFromState {
  return {
    camera: { position:{...state.camera.position}, fov:state.camera.fov },

    [earthId]: state.earth,
```

```typescript

}
```

In `resource/ts/ui/ContactWizard.ts` (lines 406-430):

The `_syncPrimaryAction()` method toggles button states:
```typescript
button.classList.toggle("no-wizard-action--next", !isSubmitMode);
button.classList.toggle("no-wizard-action--submit", isSubmitMode);
button.disabled = this._submitting;  // Disabled when submitting
```

**Button states:**
- **NEXT mode**: When not on final step (button type="button", has `data-wizard-next`)
- **SUBMIT mode**: On final step (button type="submit", has no `data-wizard-next`)
- **Disabled**: When `this._submitting` is true (aria-disabled="true")
